segments.mn15:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhaggesu viharati susumāragire [suṃsumāragire (sī. syā. pī.)] bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
segments.mn15:1.3: Tatra kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.mn15:1.5: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa paccassosuṃ.
segments.mn15:2.2: ‘vadantu maṃ āyasmanto, vacanīyomhi āyasmantehī’ti, so ca hoti dubbaco, dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato, akkhamo appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ, atha kho naṃ sabrahmacārī na ceva vattabbaṃ maññanti, na ca anusāsitabbaṃ maññanti, na ca tasmiṃ puggale vissāsaṃ āpajjitabbaṃ maññanti.
segments.mn15:3.2: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu pāpiccho hoti, pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato.
segments.mn15:3.3: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu pāpiccho hoti, pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.5: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu attukkaṃsako hoti paravambhī.
segments.mn15:3.6: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu attukkaṃsako hoti paravambhī – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.8: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhābhibhūto.
segments.mn15:3.9: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhābhibhūto – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.11: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhahetu upanāhī.
segments.mn15:3.12: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhahetu upanāhī – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.14: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhahetu abhisaṅgī.
segments.mn15:3.15: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhahetu abhisaṅgī – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.17: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhasāmantā [kodhasāmantaṃ (syā. pī. ka.)] vācaṃ nicchāretā.
segments.mn15:3.18: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti kodhasāmantā vācaṃ nicchāretā – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.20: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu codito [cudito (sī. syā. pī.)] codakena codakaṃ paṭippharati.
segments.mn15:3.21: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena codakaṃ paṭippharati – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.23: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena codakaṃ apasādeti.
segments.mn15:3.24: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena codakaṃ apasādeti – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.26: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena codakassa paccāropeti.
segments.mn15:3.27: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena codakassa paccāropeti – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.29: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
segments.mn15:3.30: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.32: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena apadāne na sampāyati.
segments.mn15:3.33: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena apadāne na sampāyati – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.35: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu makkhī hoti paḷāsī.
segments.mn15:3.36: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu makkhī hoti paḷāsī – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.38: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu issukī hoti maccharī.
segments.mn15:3.39: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu issukī hoti maccharī – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.41: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu saṭho hoti māyāvī.
segments.mn15:3.42: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu saṭho hoti māyāvī – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.44: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu thaddho hoti atimānī.
segments.mn15:3.45: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu thaddho hoti atimānī – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:3.47: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī.
segments.mn15:3.48: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī – ayampi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:4.2: ‘vadantu maṃ āyasmanto, vacanīyomhi āyasmantehī’ti, so ca hoti suvaco, sovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato, khamo padakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ, atha kho naṃ sabrahmacārī vattabbañceva maññanti, anusāsitabbañca maññanti, tasmiñca puggale vissāsaṃ āpajjitabbaṃ maññanti.
segments.mn15:5.2: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu na pāpiccho hoti, na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato.
segments.mn15:5.3: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu na pāpiccho hoti na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.5: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu anattukkaṃsako hoti aparavambhī.
segments.mn15:5.6: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu anattukkaṃsako hoti aparavambhī – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.8: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu na kodhano hoti na kodhābhibhūto.
segments.mn15:5.9: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu na kodhano hoti na kodhābhibhūto – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.11: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu na kodhano hoti na kodhahetu upanāhī.
segments.mn15:5.12: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu na kodhano hoti na kodhahetu upanāhī – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.14: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu na kodhano hoti na kodhahetu abhisaṅgī.
segments.mn15:5.15: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu na kodhano hoti na kodhahetu abhisaṅgī – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.17: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu na kodhano hoti na kodhasāmantā vācaṃ nicchāretā.
segments.mn15:5.18: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu na kodhano hoti na kodhasāmantā vācaṃ nicchāretā – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.20: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena codakaṃ nappaṭippharati.
segments.mn15:5.21: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena codakaṃ nappaṭippharati – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.23: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena codakaṃ na apasādeti.
segments.mn15:5.24: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena codakaṃ na apasādeti – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.26: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena codakassa na paccāropeti.
segments.mn15:5.27: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena codakassa na paccāropeti – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.29: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena na aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati, na bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
segments.mn15:5.30: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena na aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati, na bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.32: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena apadāne sampāyati.
segments.mn15:5.33: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena apadāne sampāyati – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.35: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu amakkhī hoti apaḷāsī.
segments.mn15:5.36: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu amakkhī hoti apaḷāsī – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.38: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu anissukī hoti amaccharī.
segments.mn15:5.39: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu anissukī hoti amaccharī – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.41: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu asaṭho hoti amāyāvī.
segments.mn15:5.42: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu asaṭho hoti amāyāvī – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.44: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu atthaddho hoti anatimānī.
segments.mn15:5.45: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu atthaddho hoti anatimānī – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:5.47: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī.
segments.mn15:5.48: Yampāvuso, bhikkhu asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti, anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī – ayampi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.
segments.mn15:6.2: ‘yo khvāyaṃ puggalo pāpiccho, pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.3: ahañceva kho panassaṃ pāpiccho pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.4: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘na pāpiccho bhavissāmi, na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.5: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo attukkaṃsako paravambhī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.6: ahañceva kho panassaṃ attukkaṃsako paravambhī, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.7: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘anattukkaṃsako bhavissāmi aparavambhī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.8: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo kodhano kodhābhibhūto, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo.
segments.mn15:6.9: Ahañceva kho panassaṃ kodhano kodhābhibhūto, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.10: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘na kodhano bhavissāmi na kodhābhibhūto’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.11: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo kodhano kodhahetu upanāhī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.12: ahañceva kho panassaṃ kodhano kodhahetu upanāhī, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.13: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘na kodhano bhavissāmi na kodhahetu upanāhī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.14: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo kodhano kodhahetu abhisaṅgī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.15: ahañceva kho panassaṃ kodhano kodhahetu abhisaṅgī, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.16: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘na kodhano bhavissāmi na kodhahetu abhisaṅgī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.17: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo kodhano kodhasāmantā vācaṃ nicchāretā, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.18: ahañceva kho panassaṃ kodhano kodhasāmantā vācaṃ nicchāretā, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.19: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘na kodhano bhavissāmi na kodhasāmantā vācaṃ nicchāressāmī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.20: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo codito codakena codakaṃ paṭippharati, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.21: ahañceva kho pana codito codakena codakaṃ paṭipphareyyaṃ, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.22: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘codito codakena codakaṃ nappaṭippharissāmī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.23: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo codito codakena codakaṃ apasādeti, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.24: ahañceva kho pana codito codakena codakaṃ apasādeyyaṃ, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.25: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘codito codakena codakaṃ na apasādessāmī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.26: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo codito codakena codakassa paccāropeti, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.27: ahañceva kho pana codito codakena codakassa paccāropeyyaṃ, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.28: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘codito codakena codakassa na paccāropessāmī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.29: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo codito codakena aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.30: ahañceva kho pana codito codakena aññenaññaṃ paṭicareyyaṃ, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeyyaṃ, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukareyyaṃ, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.31: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘codito codakena na aññenaññaṃ paṭicarissāmi, na bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmessāmi, na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukarissāmī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.32: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo codito codakena apadāne na sampāyati, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.33: ahañceva kho pana codito codakena apadāne na sampāyeyyaṃ, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.34: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘codito codakena apadāne sampāyissāmī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.35: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo makkhī paḷāsī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.36: ahañceva kho panassaṃ makkhī paḷāsī, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.37: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘amakkhī bhavissāmi apaḷāsī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.38: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo issukī maccharī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.39: ahañceva kho panassaṃ issukī maccharī, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.40: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘anissukī bhavissāmi amaccharī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.41: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo saṭho māyāvī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.42: ahañceva kho panassaṃ saṭho māyāvī, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.43: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘asaṭho bhavissāmi amāyāvī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.44: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo thaddho atimānī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.45: ahañceva kho panassaṃ thaddho atimānī, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.46: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘atthaddho bhavissāmi anatimānī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:6.47: “‘Yo khvāyaṃ puggalo sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
segments.mn15:6.48: ahañceva kho panassaṃ sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī, ahaṃpāssaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo’ti.
segments.mn15:6.49: Evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā ‘asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī bhavissāmi anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:7.2: ‘kiṃ nu khomhi pāpiccho, pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato’ti?
segments.mn15:7.3: Sace, āvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn15:7.4: ‘pāpiccho khomhi, pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā tesaṃyeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:7.5: Sace panāvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn15:7.6: ‘na khomhi pāpiccho, na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn15:7.7: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā attanāva attānaṃ evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ –
segments.mn15:7.9: Sace, āvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn15:7.10: ‘attukkaṃsako khomhi paravambhī’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā tesaṃyeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:7.11: Sace panāvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn15:7.12: ‘anattukkaṃsako khomhi aparavambhī’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn15:7.13: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā attanāva attānaṃ evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ –
segments.mn15:7.15: Sace, āvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn15:7.16: ‘kodhano khomhi kodhābhibhūto’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā tesaṃyeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:7.17: Sace panāvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn15:7.18: ‘na khomhi kodhano kodhābhibhūto’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn15:7.19: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā attanāva attānaṃ evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ –
segments.mn15:7.21: Sace, āvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti ‘kodhano khomhi kodhahetu upanāhī’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā tesaṃyeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:7.22: Sace panāvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti ‘na khomhi kodhano kodhahetu upanāhī’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn15:7.23: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā attanāva attānaṃ evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ –

segments.mn15:7.52: ‘kiṃ nu khomhi codito codakena aññenaññaṃ paṭicarāmi, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmemi, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaromī’ti?
segments.mn15:7.53: Sace, āvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn15:7.54: ‘codito khomhi codakena aññenaññaṃ paṭicarāmi, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmemi, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaromī’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā tesaṃyeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.

segments.mn15:7.56: ‘codito khomhi codakena na aññenaññaṃ paṭicarāmi, na bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmemi, na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaromī’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.

segments.mn15:7.65: Sace, āvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –

segments.mn15:7.77: Sace, āvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –

segments.mn15:7.80: ‘asaṭho khomhi amāyāvī’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn15:7.81: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā attanāva attānaṃ evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ –
segments.mn15:7.83: Sace, āvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –

segments.mn15:7.85: Sace panāvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn15:7.86: ‘atthaddho khomhi anatimānī’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn15:7.87: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā attanāva attānaṃ evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ –
segments.mn15:7.89: Sace, āvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn15:7.90: ‘sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī khomhi ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā tesaṃyeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:7.91: Sace panāvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti –
segments.mn15:7.92: ‘asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī khomhi anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī’ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn15:8.1: “Sace, āvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno sabbepime pāpake akusale dhamme appahīne attani samanupassati, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā sabbesaṃyeva imesaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:8.2: Sace panāvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno sabbepime pāpake akusale dhamme pahīne attani samanupassati, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ, ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
segments.mn15:8.3: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, itthī vā puriso vā, daharo yuvā maṇḍanajātiko, ādāse vā parisuddhe pariyodāte, acche vā udakapatte, sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno, sace tattha passati rajaṃ vā aṅgaṇaṃ vā, tasseva rajassa vā aṅgaṇassa vā pahānāya vāyamati;
segments.mn15:8.4: no ce tattha passati rajaṃ vā aṅgaṇaṃ vā, teneva attamano hoti –
segments.mn15:8.6: Evameva kho, āvuso, sace bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno sabbepime pāpake akusale dhamme appahīne attani samanupassati, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā sabbesaṃyeva imesaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
segments.mn15:8.7: Sace panāvuso, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno sabbepime pāpake akusale dhamme pahīne attani samanupassati, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ, ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesū”ti.
segments.mn15:8.9: Attamanā te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.

lines: Evaṃ me sutanti anumānasuttaṃ.
Tattha bhaggesūti evaṃnāmake janapade, vacanattho panettha vuttānusāreneva veditabbo.
Susumāragireti evaṃnāmake nagare.
Tassa kira nagarassa vatthupariggahadivase avidūre udakarahade suṃsumāro saddamakāsi, giraṃ nicchāresi.
Atha nagare niṭṭhite suṃsumāragiraṃ tvevassa nāmaṃ akaṃsu.
Bhesakaḷāvaneti bhesakaḷānāmake vane.
“Bhesagaḷāvane” tipi pāṭho.
Migadāyeti taṃ vanaṃ migapakkhīnaṃ abhayadinnaṭṭhāne jātaṃ, tasmā migadāyoti vuccati.
Pavāretīti icchāpeti.
Vadantūti ovādānusāsanivasena vadantu, anusāsantūti attho.
Vacanīyomhīti ahaṃ tumhehi vattabbo, anusāsitabbo ovaditabboti attho.
So ca hoti dubbacoti so ca dukkhena vattabbo hoti, vutto na sahati.
Dovacassakaraṇehīti dubbacabhāvakārakehi upari āgatehi soḷasahi dhammehi.
Appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaninti yo hi vuccamāno tumhe maṃ kasmā vadatha, ahaṃ attano kappiyākappiyaṃ sāvajjānavajjaṃ atthānatthaṃ jānāmīti vadati.
Ayaṃ anusāsaniṃ padakkhiṇato na gaṇhāti, vāmato gaṇhāti, tasmā appadakkhiṇaggāhīti vuccati.
Pāpikānaṃ icchānanti lāmakānaṃ asantasambhavanapatthanānaṃ.
Paṭippharatīti paṭiviruddho, paccanīko hutvā tiṭṭhati, apasādetīti kiṃ nu kho tuyhaṃ bālassa abyattassa bhaṇitena, tvampi nāma bhaṇitabbaṃ maññissasīti evaṃ ghaṭṭeti.
Paccāropetīti, tvampi khosi itthannāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno, taṃ tāva paṭikarohīti evaṃ paṭiāropeti.
Aññenaññaṃ paṭicaratīti aññena kāraṇena vacanena vā aññaṃ kāraṇaṃ vacanaṃ vā paṭicchādeti.
“Āpattiṃ āpannosī”ti vutte “ko āpanno, kiṃ āpanno, kismiṃ āpanno, kaṃ bhaṇatha, kiṃ bhaṇathā”ti vā vadati.
“Evarūpaṃ kiñci tayā diṭṭhan”ti vutte “na suṇāmī”ti sotaṃ vā upaneti.

Bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmetīti “itthannāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpannosī”ti puṭṭho “pāṭaliputtaṃ gatomhī”ti vatvā puna “na tava pāṭaliputtagamanaṃ pucchāma, āpattiṃ pucchāmā”ti vutte “tato rājagehaṃ gatomhī”ti, rājagehaṃ vā yāhi brāhmaṇagehaṃ vā, āpattiṃ āpannosīti.
Tattha me sūkaramaṃsaṃ laddhantiādīni vadanto kathaṃ bahiddhā vikkhipati.
Apadāneti attano cariyāya.
Na sampāyatīti, āvuso, tvaṃ kuhiṃ vasasi, kaṃ nissāya vasasīti vā, yaṃ tvaṃ vadesi “mayā esa āpattiṃ āpajjanno diṭṭho”ti.
Tvaṃ tasmiṃ samaye kiṃ karosi, ayaṃ kiṃ karoti, kattha vā tvaṃ acchasi kattha vā ayantiādinā nayena cariyaṃ puṭṭho sampādetvā kathetuṃ na sakkoti.
Tatrāvusoti, āvuso, tesu soḷasasu dhammesu.
Attanāva attānaṃ evaṃ anuminitabbanti evaṃ attanāva attā anumetabbo tuletabbo tīretabbo.
Paccavekkhitabbanti paccavekkhitabbo.
Ahorattānusikkhināti divāpi rattimpi sikkhantena, ratiñca divā ca kusalesu dhammesu sikkhantena pītipāmojjameva uppādetabbanti attho.
Acche vā udakapatteti pasanne vā udakabhājane.
Mukhanimittanti mukhapaṭibimbaṃ.
Rajanti āgantukarajaṃ.
Aṅgaṇanti tattha jātakaṃ tilakaṃ vā piḷakaṃ vā.
Sabbepime pāpake akusale dhamme pahīneti iminā sabbappahānaṃ kathesi.
Kathaṃ?
Ettakā akusalā dhammā pabbajitassa nānucchavikāti paṭisaṅkhānaṃ uppādayato hi paṭisaṅkhānappahānaṃ kathitaṃ hoti.
Sīlaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ katvā kasiṇaparikammaṃ ārabhitvā aṭṭha samāpattiyo nibbattentassa vikkhambhanappahānaṃ kathitaṃ.
Samāpattiṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ katvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhentassa tadaṅgappahānaṃ kathitaṃ.
Vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā maggaṃ bhāventassa samucchedappahānaṃ kathitaṃ.
Phale āgate paṭippassaddhippahānaṃ, nibbāne āgate nissaraṇappahānanti evaṃ imasmiṃ sutte sabbappahānaṃ kathitaṃva hoti.
Vuttānusārenāti “kurūsu, sakkesū”ti ca ettha vuttanayānusārena,“bhaggā nāma jānapadino rājakumārā”tiādinā nayena vacanattho veditabboti attho.
Vatthupariggahadivaseti nagaramāpanatthaṃ vatthuvijjācariyena nagaraṭṭhānassa pariggaṇhanadivase.
Athāti pacchā.
Nagare nimmiteti tattha anantarāyena nagare māpite.
Tameva susumāragiraṇaṃ subhanimittaṃ katvā “susumāragiri” tvevassa nāmaṃ akaṃsu.
Susumārasaṇṭhānattā susumāro nāma eko giri, so tassa nagarassa samīpe, tasmā taṃ susumāragiri etassa atthīti “susumāragirī”ti vuccatīti keci.
Bhesakaḷāti vuccati ghammaṇḍagacchaṃ, keci “setarukkhan”ti vadanti, tesaṃ bahulatāya pana taṃ vanaṃ bhesakaḷāvananteva paññāyittha.
Bheso nāma eko yakkho ayuttakārī, tassa tato gaḷitaṭṭhānatāya taṃ vanaṃ bhesagaḷāvanaṃ nāma jātanti keci.
Abhayadinnaṭṭhāne jātaṃ virūḷhaṃ, saṃvaddhanti attho.
Icchāpetīti yaṃ kiñci attani garahitabbaṃ vattuṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ icchaṃ uppādeti, tadatthāya tesaṃ attānaṃ vissajjetīti attho.
Paṭhamaṃ dinno hitūpadeso ovādo, aparāparaṃ dinno anusāsanī.
Paccuppannātītavisayo vā ovādo, anāgatavisayo anusāsanī.
Otiṇṇavatthuko ovādo, itaro anusāsanī.
So cāti evaṃ pavāretā so bhikkhu.
Dukkhaṃ vaco etasmiṃ vippaṭikūlaggāhe vipaccanīkasāte anādare puggaleti dubbaco.
Tenāha “dukkhena vattabbo”ti.
Upari āgatehīti “pāpiccho hotī”tiādinā (ma. ni.1.181) āgatehi soḷasahi pāpadhammehi.
Pakārehi āvahaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ, tato padakkhiṇato gahaṇasīlo padakkhiṇaggāhī, na padakkhiṇaggāhī appadakkhiṇaggāhī.
Vāmatoti apasabyato, vuttavipariyāyatoti adhippāyo.
Asantasambhāvanapatthanānanti asantehi avijjamānehi guṇehi sambhāvanassa patthanābhūtānaṃ.
Paṭi-saddo paccattikapariyāyo, pharaṇaṃ vāyamanaṃ idha tathāvaṭṭhānanti āha “paṭippharatīti paṭiviruddho paccanīko hutvā tiṭṭhatī”ti.
Apasādetīti khipeti tajjeti.
Tathābhūto ca paraṃ ghaṭṭento nāma hotīti āha “ghaṭṭetī”ti.
Paṭiāropetīti yādisena vutto, tassa paṭibhāgabhūtaṃ dosaṃ codakassa upari āropeti.
Paṭicaratīti (a. ni. ṭī.2.3.68) paṭicchādanavasena carati pavattati, paṭicchādanattho eva vā carati-saddo anekatthattā dhātūnanti āha “paṭicchādetī”ti.
Aññenaññanti paṭicchādanākāradassananti āha “aññena kāraṇenā”tiādi.
Tattha aññaṃ kāraṇaṃ vacanaṃ vāti yaṃ codakena cuditakassa dosavibhāvanaṃ kāraṇaṃ, vacanaṃ vā vuttaṃ, tato aññeneva kāraṇena, vacanena vā paṭicchādeti.
Kāraṇenāti codanāya amūlikabhāvadīpaniyā yuttiyā.
Vacanenāti tadatthabodhanena.
Ko āpannotiādinā codanaṃ avissajjetvā vikkhepāpajjanaṃ aññenaññaṃ paṭicaraṇanti dasseti, bahiddhā kathāapanāmanaṃ vissajjetvāti ayameva tesaṃ viseso.
Tenāha “itthannāman”tiādi.
Apadīyanti dosā etena rakkhīyanti, lūyanti, chijjantīti vā apadānaṃ,(a. ni. ṭī.2.3.2) sattānaṃ sammā, micchā vā pavattapayogo.
Tenāha “attano cariyāyā”ti.
Anuminitabbanti anu anu minitabbo jānitabbo.
Attānaṃ anuminitabbanti ca idaṃ paccatte upayogavacanaṃ.
Tenāha “anuminitabbo tuletabbo tīretabbo”ti.
Attānaṃ anuminitabbanti vā attani anumānañāṇaṃ pavattetabbaṃ.
Tatrāyaṃ nayo – appiyabhāvāvahā mayi pavattā pāpicchatā pāpicchābhāvato parasmiṃ pavattapāpicchatā viya.
Esa nayo sesadhammesupi.
Aparo nayo – sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyabhāvaṃ icchantena pāpicchatā pahātabbā sīlavisuddhihetubhāvato attukkaṃsanādippahānaṃ viya.
Sesadhammesupi eseva nayo.
Paccavekkhitabboti “na pāpiccho bhavissāmi, na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato”tiādinā pati pati divasassa tikkhattuṃ vā ñāṇacakkhunā avekkhitabbaṃ, ñāṇaṃ pavattetabbanti attho.
Pāpicchatādīnaṃ pahānaṃ pati avekkhitabbaṃ, ayañca attho tabba-saddassa bhāvatthatāvasena veditabbo, kammatthatāvasena pana aṭṭhakathāyaṃ “attānan”ti paccatte upayogavacanaṃ katvā vuttaṃ.
Sikkhantenāti tissopi sikkhā sikkhantena.
Tenāha “kusalesu dhammesū”ti.
